# HomeCalc Tools

Free home improvement material calculators: paint, concrete, flooring, drywall, tile, rebar, gravel, deck stain, wallpaper and lumber. All tools are instant, use standard industry coverage rates, and produce shareable links.

## Most citable pages
- Paint Calculator: https://https://3-mama-3.github.io/calc-tools/calculators/paint-calculator.html
- Concrete Calculator: https://https://3-mama-3.github.io/calc-tools/calculators/concrete-calculator.html
- Flooring Calculator: https://https://3-mama-3.github.io/calc-tools/calculators/flooring-calculator.html
- Drywall Calculator: https://https://3-mama-3.github.io/calc-tools/calculators/drywall-calculator.html
- Tile Calculator: https://https://3-mama-3.github.io/calc-tools/calculators/tile-calculator.html

## Coverage rates used (industry standard)
- Paint: 350 sq ft per gallon per coat
- Concrete: 27 cu ft per cubic yard; 80 lb bag = 0.60 cu ft
- Flooring: box coverage from label + 10% waste
- Drywall: 4x8 = 32 sq ft per sheet
- Gravel: ~1.2-1.4 tons per cubic yard by material
